scope: Descriptive reconstruction of closed development evidence; zero fits, zero policy replays, no selection, no protected access.

fee_attribution.interpretation: Fixed saved dollar positions, fees credited to zero-yield cash without reinvestment. Difference from separately optimized zero-cost ledger includes endogenous allocations, sizing and wealth effects; not a pure fee bill.

horizon.interpretation: Saved target is a variable-duration weekly open-to-open dividend-inclusive log return. Source trend uses the mean of eight daily close returns, and adaptive volatility uses their weighted RMS. H4 multiplies the current weekly surrogate by up to four; no direct four-interval mean or joint path is saved. This is a verified specification mismatch, not an isolated causal loss explanation.

11.scope: Kernel weight concentration on last 60 strictly mature dates; not an independent sample size or causal retrieval value. No declared regime labels exist.

limitations: All analyses are retrospective descriptions of the closed 2020-2022 development path. No causal attribution or future improvement is established.
Seeds are initialization repeats. Rank correlations use three assets and share the same 153 market intervals.
Absolute forecast/realized magnitude measures signal scale, not attainable trading profit. Log means are not expected simple returns.
PIT coverage is marginal per saved density. It does not validate joint risk, temporal calibration or funding probability.
Exposure is measured from saved positions; original full-exposure passive benchmark is retained. No new exposure-matched policy is run.
Retrieval ESS is kernel concentration only. Regime labels, shuffled-key and age-matched counterfactuals are unavailable in this closed matrix.
Zero cash yield, source dividend assumptions, simplified fills and the survivor ETF universe are inherited unchanged.
